summary.text: Sean Bagniewski is a Democratic state representative who has represented Iowa House District 35 since 2023 and is seeking re-election in the November 3, 2026 general election.
Ballotpedia lists a career as an attorney, among other roles.

paragraphs.text: Sean Bagniewski earned a B.S. in political science from Truman State University in 2005 and a J.D. from Drake University in 2008, according to Ballotpedia.
Bagniewski's career experience includes working as an attorney, a federal contract administrator with the Polk County Board of Supervisors, and a Medicaid provider services manager with Maximus.

In the 2025-2026 session Bagniewski was assigned to the Administration and Rules, House Agriculture, House Appropriations, House Commerce and House Transportation committees, as well as the Capital Projects Committee and the Legislative Council.
